groups.text: In the 2024 official sample, the first reading section contains 15 questions. Each question asks the reader to choose one answer from four options. The second section has five gaps in a text and seven sentence options. Two options are left unused. Each reading question is worth 2.5 points, giving the two sections a total of 50 points.

items.stem: How is an answer selected in the first reading section?
options: Choose one option from a set of four.
Choose five sentences from a set of seven.
Choose two sentences from a set of four.
Choose one option from a set of seven.
items.why: 依据 choose one answer from four options：阅读理解每题四选一，即第一项。

items.stem: What happens to the sentence options in the second section?
options: All seven sentences fill gaps in the text.
Five sentences are used and two remain unused.
Four sentences are used and one remains unused.
Two sentences are used and five remain unused.
items.why: 依据 five gaps 和 Two options are left unused：七个句子用五个，两个不用，即第二项。

items.stem: How many questions are in the first reading section?
options: Five questions worth 2.5 points each
Seven questions worth 2.5 points each
Fifteen questions worth 2.5 points each
Twenty questions worth 2.5 points each
items.why: 依据 the first reading section contains 15 questions，第一节有 15 题。

items.stem: How many points can be earned across both reading sections?
options: A total of 12.5 points
A total of 20 points
A total of 37.5 points
A total of 50 points
items.why: 依据 giving the two sections a total of 50 points，两节共 50 分。

groups.text: The course practice for reading comprehension uses one passage and four questions with an eight-minute limit. The course mock uses four comprehension passages with 15 questions, followed by five sentence-selection questions. Its limit is 39 minutes for both sections. These are course settings, not official section time limits. The official number of comprehension passages has not been confirmed here.

items.stem: What is the status of the 39-minute limit?
options: It is an official limit for comprehension alone.
It is a course limit for both reading sections.
It is an official limit for sentence selection alone.
It is a course limit for one practice passage.
items.why: 依据 Its limit is 39 minutes for both sections 和 These are course settings：39 分钟是课程给两节合计的时间，即第二项。

items.stem: What does the course mock include?
options: One comprehension passage and five sentence-selection questions
Four comprehension passages and four sentence-selection questions
One comprehension passage and 15 sentence-selection questions
Four comprehension passages and five sentence-selection questions
items.why: 依据 four comprehension passages 和 five sentence-selection questions：模拟测试有四篇阅读理解和五道选句题，即第四项。
